name: droidex
description: DROIDEX desktop agent workspace for Factory Droid.
author: DROIDEX

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run sidecar:build && npm run electron:check
scripts.dist:mac: npm run sparkle:prepare && npm run assets:build && npm run build && SPARKLE_FEED_URL=https://github.com/droidex-anas/droidex-releases/releases/latest/download/appcast-x64.xml electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never -c electron-builder.config.cjs && SPARKLE_FEED_URL=https://github.com/droidex-anas/droidex-releases/releases/latest/download/appcast-arm64.xml electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never -c electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run sparkle:prepare && npm run assets:build && npm run build && SPARKLE_FEED_URL=https://github.com/droidex-anas/droidex-releases/releases/latest/download/appcast-arm64.xml electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never -c electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.electron:check: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/applicationMenu.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/nativeBrowserPreload.cjs && node --check electron/dev.cjs && node --check electron/git.cjs && node --check electron/github.cjs && node --check electron/notifications.cjs && node --check electron/terminal.cjs && node --check electron/files.cjs && node --check electron/attachments.cjs && node --check electron/sidecar.cjs && node --check electron/rendererSecurity.cjs && node --check electron/appUpdater.cjs && node --check electron/diagnostics.cjs
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test --test-reporter=spec "src/**/*.test.ts" && node --test electron/applicationMenu.test.cjs electron/builderConfig.test.cjs electron/files.test.cjs electron/git.test.cjs electron/github.test.cjs electron/notifications.test.cjs electron/preload.test.cjs electron/terminal.test.cjs electron/attachments.test.cjs electron/sidecar.test.cjs electron/rendererSecurity.test.cjs electron/mainRegression.test.cjs electron/appUpdater.test.cjs electron/diagnostics.test.cjs
scripts.test:flaky: mkdir -p reports && node tools/run-flaky-check.mjs reports/frontend-reruns.json -- node --import tsx --test --test-reporter=spec "src/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:smoke:electron-droid: npm run build && RUN_AUTHENTICATED_DROID_SMOKE=1 playwright test --config=playwright.droid-smoke.config.ts
scripts.precommit: lint-staged && npm run quality:file-size && npm run quality:tech-debt && npm run typecheck && npm run sidecar:typecheck && npm run electron:check
